svg.title: We check who can actually deliver, before your money moves.
svg.desc: YaVaKa vets contractors and prices work against a bill of quantities before a diaspora client commits funds.
svg.text: Most builds abroad pick a contractor first and look for proof later.
We do it the other way round. Less exciting, considerably cheaper.
Completed builds, reference sites, people who take our call
A bill of quantities, not a phone estimate
Programme, retention, penalties and payment gates
Every receipt, invoice and document — at every
stage — in your YaVaKa portal. Private to your
